project_type: Python FastAPI enterprise document management system with LLM-powered wiki
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, async fixtures in tests/conftest.py using httpx ASGITransport
verification_instructions: 1. Run uv sync to install deps. 2. Run uv run pytest tests/ -v to verify all tests pass. 3. Run uv run ruff check app/ tests/ to verify no lint errors.
setup_instructions: 1. pyenv local 3.11.15  2. uv sync  3. Create .env with required variables
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.11.14 via pyenv. No Docker daemon needed for tests. SQLite for testing, PostgreSQL for production.
contribution_requirements: Use uv for dependency management. Tests use pytest-asyncio with async fixtures. All async endpoints use SQLAlchemy async sessions.
key_patterns: FastAPI routers in app/api/ with APIRouter. SQLAlchemy ORM models in app/models/ inheriting from Base. Pydantic schemas in app/schemas/. Business logic in app/services/. Config via pydantic-settings in app/core/config.py. Tests use httpx AsyncClient with ASGITransport. Test DB is fresh SQLite per test via tmp_path fixture.
directory_structure: app/ - main package (api/, core/, models/, schemas/, services/, templates/). tests/ - pytest tests. docs/ - documentation. wiki/ - LLM wiki storage. storage/ - file storage. chroma_db/ - vector DB.
